svg.title: Equilateral chamfered cube: 12 hexagons and 6 squares
svg.desc: Unit-edge net with six horizontal alternating hexagons. Top attachments SH--SH--SH--; bottom HS--HS--HS--, left to right. Hexagon angles: 109.471220634491 degrees twice at opposite vertices, 125.264389682755 degrees four times. Square angles: 90 degrees. Cut solid lines, fold dashed lines, and join identical E labels. Cut vertex copies coincide only after folding. JSON supplies their exact correspondence.
svg.text: 12 hexagons + 6 squares | all edges equal | fixed, non-overlapping net
Solid: cut | Dashed: fold | Join matching E labels (31 seam pairs) | No glue tabs
